beats.text: Five daily habits that slowly rewire your brain for sharper focus.
One. Single-task. Every time you resist switching, you strengthen the circuit for deep attention.
Two. Sit in boredom now and then. A mind that's always stimulated forgets how to concentrate.
Three. Move daily. Exercise literally grows new connections in the brain's memory centres.
Four. Protect your sleep. It's when the brain clears waste and locks in what you learned.
Five. Learn something hard on purpose. Difficulty is the signal that tells the brain to adapt.
Your brain changes shape around whatever you repeatedly do. Choose those repetitions on purpose.
